summary_en: 236,560 shares to be cancelled (2.64% of shares outstanding ex-treasury). Effective date 2026-09-28. Post-cancellation issued share count: 8,733,440 shares. Cancellation conditional on shareholder approval of stock split (effective 2026-09-29) at extraordinary general meeting scheduled 2026-08-25.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 29 July 2026, The Kodensha's board of directors resolved to cancel 236,560 treasury shares held by the company, effective 2026-09-28, pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act. This represents 2.64% of shares outstanding (computed as 236,560 ÷ 8,969,160 ex-treasury shares before cancellation). Following the cancellation, issued share count will stand at 8,733,440 shares. The cancellation is conditional on shareholder approval of a stock split (effective 2026-09-29) at an extraordinary general meeting scheduled for 2026-08-25. As of the meeting record date (2026-07-15), these 236,560 shares constitute the entirety of treasury shares held.
